passages.section: Trying to satisfy the hypotheses with cheap data
passages.quote:
But if the full
`CellSystemCondition` holds with zero cells, the number of multipliers $k$ is
zero: every actuator then vanishes by the support theorem, and the coercive
estimate applied to the zero perturbation gives
$\omega^2\sum_i\kappa_i^2\le0$ for every multiplier vector, with
$\omega>0$.

anchor.heading: Trying to satisfy the hypotheses with cheap data

The
[certificate-checker page](certificate-checker.md) sets out what a checker
has to establish for the implication above to hold: every field of
`CellSystemCondition` traced to its terminal comparisons, the places where a
natural implementation would check too little, a data schema that can be
written before release, and a plan for checking the certificate
independently of the authors' program.

Breakdown.breakdown_on_space.text: The written profile premise includes extra decay bounds, and the conclusion retains nonexistence for every positive viscosity while omitting the constructed trajectory, rate and convergence in Theorem 1.1. Relating the paper and formal endpoints uses the analytic bridges described in the authors’ README.

Breakdown.breakdown_on_torus.text: The formal conclusion excludes a larger pressure class than the paper’s periodic-pressure formulation and omits the trajectory, rate and convergence of (1.7). The hypothesis also writes additional profile decay bounds, so a single unqualified stronger/weaker label would hide changes in both directions.

Breakdown.breakdown_on_space_of_weak.text: The paper has no theorem with precisely this explicit weak-profile hypothesis and direct whole-space endpoint. Its related route is regularization in Proposition 7.11 followed by Theorem 1.1.

Breakdown.certificate_orbit.text: The input is the earlier box-and-local-ball certificate, whereas the paper uses a finite-row seminorm and a mixed box/ellipsoid with adjoint conditions. The exported output is coarser than Theorem 7.1, recording only weak-profile existence and hiding the selected witness and bounds.

Breakdown.extended_certificate_orbit.text: The extended predicate adds representative and regularity conditions, and the exported conclusion records only weak-profile existence. The paper’s Theorem 7.1 retains α, its period, all prescribed symmetries and the bounds (7.38); these are not all exposed by this theorem type.
